lines.1: How far was she planning to keep charging ahead like this...?
lines.10: For the first time in my life, I had seriously struck a girl.
lines.12: The fact that I'd hit her hurt me too, more than I could put into words.
lines.14: Yoshimi stood there stunned, her cheek still smarting from the slap.
lines.16: 「I... I want to be happy with you, Leo. And for that to happen, I have to bring Ellie down...」
lines.17: 「So the two of us can be happy.」
lines.19: 「Yes... That's what I've been telling you.」
lines.20: 「If I become happy... maybe I'll stop having that dream.」
lines.21: 「But you know... you don't trust me, your boyfriend, or the Princess, your best friend. Do you?」
